description:
Established in April 2000, Repco Home Finance Ltd. is a registered housing finance company. It is a subsidiary of the Repatriates Cooperative Finance and Development Bank Limited(Repco Bank). [1] [2]

Key Points:
Business Segments: [1] a) Individual Home Loans : The Co. offers several products for the Construction /Purchase and Repair/ Renovation of homes like Dream Home Loan, Plot loan, Super Loan, Repco Privilege, Home Makeover Loan, etc. b) Loans Against Property (LAP) : The Co. also offers loans against properties under products like the Prosperity loan, New Horizon Loan, and Commercial Real Estate Loan.
